new_demand_backups.sequence_semantics: Requires same owner/node/beneficiary, ACK before actual release, then a journalled native restore and actual first service. Missing such a chain is unknown, not proof of no release. No physical slot lineage or counterfactual mandatory-D2H proof.
new_demand_backups.semantics: New backups issued for an actual demand-deficit consumer; ACK proves Host copy, not subsequent physical release, unique bytes, mandatory sequencing or benefit. Does not enumerate native LRU writebacks.

limitations: Raw logical fit does not establish physical allocation, safe cold donors or immediate GPU execution.
Snapshot values are held for at most two seconds; unknown intervals remain unobserved.
The first-eight reconstruction uses observed native worker completion, not exact dictionary removal timestamps; boundary positions are diagnostic.
Reasons describe existing filters and windows, not the causal JCT effect of changing them.
Backed releases and new-D2H backups are different events; neither enumerates all mandatory A-before-B dependencies.
Native evictability is not useful-agent residency, coldness, or SM utilization.
